bias.en: Neutral · rejected at $359, back in the range
bias.zh: 中性 · 在 $359 受阻，回到区间内

read.en: Alphabet fell 1.7% on Oct 14 to $347.64 after an early push to $359.40 faded. It closed below its 5-day ($350.8), 10-day ($348.1) and falling 100-day ($351.7) averages, and above the 30-day ($344.4) and 200-day ($340.6). MACD is still above its signal (since Oct 5) with a narrowing histogram, Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 8 ($337.6), and RSI is 51.
read.zh: Alphabet 10月14日早盘冲高至 $359.40 后回落，下跌 1.7%，收于 $347.64。股价收于 5 日（$350.8）、10 日（$348.1）和下行的 100 日均线（$351.7）下方，并在 30 日（$344.4）和 200 日均线（$340.6）上方。MACD 仍位于信号线上方（自 10月5日起），柱状图收窄，抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看多（$337.6），RSI 为 51。

read.en: The break above $358.6 did not hold and the $352 support (100 and 5-day averages) gave way, so that zone is now first resistance, then $359.4 (Oct 13–14 highs) and $364 (Sep 22 high). The day's low of $346.34 held the $344–348 zone (10 and 30-day averages). Below it are $337.5 (SAR) and $327.7 (Sep 10 low). A close above $359.4 would target $364.
read.zh: 突破 $358.6 未能守住，$352 支撑（100 日和 5 日均线）失守，该区域现为第一阻力，其次 $359.4（10月13–14日高点）和 $364（9月22日高点）。当日低点 $346.34 守住 $344–348 区域（10 日和 30 日均线）。其下为 $337.5（SAR）和 $327.7（9月10日低点）。若收盘站上 $359.4，目标看 $364。

r.en: Sep 22 high, top of the 3-week range
